errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the values for the orange line (Други/Other) for the years 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020. It uses values that belong to the gray line (Жилищни/Residential) or are simply incorrect. The correct values for the orange line are 5460 (2017), 4826 (2018), 4608 (2019), and 3944 (2020). The description lists 5562, 5774, 4980, and 5860 for these years, respectively.

The description incorrectly lists the values for the gray line (Жилищни/Residential) for the years 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020. It uses the values that belong to the orange line (Други/Other) for those years. The correct values for the gray line are 5562 (2017), 5774 (2018), 5980 (2019), and 5860 (2020). The description lists 5460, 4826, 4608, and 3944, which are the values for the orange line.
